lines: This plan covers 3 days, starting today.
You cook on Tuesday and Saturday, and that is what was kept.
To stay inside it, expensive proteins give first, then out-of-season produce, then variety — never the portions.

dishes.name: Sunshine Scrambled Eggs
dishes.title: Scrambled eggs with vine tomatoes on sourdough
dishes.method: Whisk the eggs and scramble them gently in a pan with butter. Toast the sourdough and serve with the fresh tomatoes on the side.
dishes.why: A high-protein, warm start to the muscle gain stretch that uses fresh summer tomatoes.

dishes.name: Summer Roast Chicken Bowls
dishes.title: Roast chicken thighs with courgettes, peppers and quinoa
dishes.method: Take one portion of the roasted chicken and vegetables and one portion of quinoa. Assemble in a bowl and finish with a squeeze of lemon.
dishes.why: Utilises the fresh batch of roast chicken and loud summer vegetables for a balanced lunch.

dishes.name: Spiced Beef Quinoa Skillet
dishes.title: Spiced beef mince with wilted spinach and quinoa
dishes.method: Warm a portion of the spiced beef and a portion of quinoa in a pan until steaming. Toss together and serve warm.
dishes.why: A warm, protein-heavy dinner to fuel muscle recovery after the first day of the stretch.

dishes.name: Berry Protein Yogurt Bowl
dishes.title: Greek yogurt with fresh raspberries and toasted oats
dishes.method: Toast the oats in a dry pan for 2 minutes. Layer the yogurt, raspberries, and oats in bowls. Drizzle with honey.
dishes.why: A clean, high-protein breakfast that requires no heavy cooking while the kitchen is being painted.

dishes.name: Harvest Chicken Salad
dishes.title: Cold roast chicken with quinoa and bell peppers
dishes.method: Combine a portion of cold roast chicken and vegetables with quinoa. Drizzle with olive oil and eat as a hearty salad.
dishes.why: Easy to eat while the kitchen table is covered, providing sustained energy for the afternoon.

dishes.name: Warm Beef and Spinach Wraps
dishes.title: Spiced beef and spinach in toasted tortillas
dishes.method: Reheat the spiced beef in a pan. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan, then fill with the beef and spinach mixture.
dishes.why: A warm, handheld dinner that is practical for a household with a disrupted kitchen space.

dishes.name: Zesty Lemon Poppy Morning
dishes.title: Greek yogurt with lemon, poppy seeds and oats
dishes.method: Mix lemon zest, poppy seeds, and honey into the yogurt. Top with oats and serve fresh.
dishes.why: Nods to the Sunday traybake request with lemon and poppy seed flavours in a high-protein format.

dishes.name: Golden Beef and Herb Quinoa
dishes.title: Spiced beef with spinach and herby quinoa
dishes.method: Reheat a portion of spiced beef and quinoa in a pan together. Serve warm.
dishes.why: High-protein lunch to support muscle gain as the stretch nears its end.

dishes.name: Beef and Spinach Toasties
dishes.title: Spiced beef and spinach on thick-cut sourdough
dishes.method: Toast the sourdough with butter. Reheat the remaining spiced beef and spinach and pile it high on the toast.
dishes.why: A warm, comforting end to the week that ensures no batch food goes to waste.

preparations.title: Roast chicken thighs with courgettes and peppers
preparations.method: Preheat oven to 200°C. Chop courgettes and peppers into large chunks. Toss veg and chicken with oil and oregano. Roast for 35-40 minutes until chicken is cooked through.

preparations.title: Herby steamed quinoa
preparations.method: Rinse quinoa and boil in salted water for 12-15 minutes. Drain and fluff with a fork, then stir through chopped parsley.

preparations.title: Spiced beef mince with spinach
preparations.method: Brown the beef in a large pan. Add spices and cook for 5 minutes. Stir in the spinach in batches until wilted.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Preheat the oven and start the chicken and vegetables roasting. While they roast, get the quinoa boiling on the hob. In a second large pan, brown the beef mince and wilt the spinach. Once all components are ready, weigh them into the named boxes for each person.
